page.layout: Heading across the top, full width. Below it one fold-out genealogical table: a main column of boxes down the left, with further columns of boxes to the right, joined by connecting lines. No running text, no page number, no catchword. A strip of the neighbouring page is at the far left edge and is not transcribed.

main_text.head: ARBOR CONSANGUINITATIS, inserenda post pag. 484.
main_text.l: III. Patruus magnus, Amita magna, Avunculus magnus, Matertera magna. 4

page.notes: Diagram, not running text: each box is one line, levels follow the columns from left to right (the leftmost column is level 1). The lines joining the boxes are not transcribed as text. The line "PETRUCIUS, VEL STIPES" stands in an ornamental frame. The heading line reads "ARBOR CONSANGUINITATIS," with the phrase "inserenda post pag. 484." beside it. The numbers in the boxes are the degree numbers as printed, including the Roman numerals. Strip of the neighbouring page at left edge and the stain/crease marks are not transcribed.
